title: Austin Decisions: Fines, Insurance, Street Work
summary:
*   **Fines Remitted:** Remitted fines for several individuals, notably excusing the remaining balance of a gaming fine for a man who died while paying it in installments.
*   **Financial Oversight:** Approved the assessments of credits for numerous insurance and bonding companies.
*   **Local Improvements:** Allocated funds for paving an alley located between Lavaca and Guadalupe streets.

Fine &c
Kreisle
remitted
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Whereas, it appears from the
information derived from Police Officer, Ed Nitschke, and from the verbal recommendation
made to the Mayor of thid City by A S Phelps, Asst City Attorney, it appears that there
might have been a mistake in the imposition of a penalty upon E C Kreisle in cause No
11954, in the Corporation Court of the City of Austin, Texas, Now, therefore, Resolved by
the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas : That the fine and costs in this cause,
amounting to $ 19.80,be and the same same are hereby remitted.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Guy Holder
Fine remitted
On motion of Councilman Anthony, the fine and costs assessed against Guy Holder in the
Recorders Court were remitted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,

Driver licenses

drivers of service cars, viz:
Ed L Borders , 55 East Avenue
Barney Blount, 417 Congress Avenue.
The licenses were granted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilman
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none.

Powell

the City of Austin, Texas: That the sum of $ 12.00, be transferred from the Sewer fund to

Be it further resolved that the City Treasurer and book-keeper be and they are hereby
authorized and instructed to make said transfer.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none,

Transfer
funds.
Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin, Texas : That the sum of $ 27.50, be and the same is hereby ordered
transferred from the general street improvement fund to the Permanent street fund to
correct an error caused by the City tax Collector depositing this amount to the general
street fund when it should have been deposited to the Permanent street fund .
Be it further resolved:
That the City Treasurer and book-keeper be and they are hereby instructed to make said
transfer.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
XXXXXX, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell, B.4
Absent Councilman Anthony 1
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.

Fine Due
Stebney
remitted
Councilman Anthony offered the following resolution : Whereas, it appears from the
attached statement of W S Walsh that Tom Stbney ,colored, was fined in cause No 11739, in
the Corporation Court of the City of Austin, Texas, for gaming,in the amount of $ 19.80;
and Whereas, the said Tom Stbney ,Colored,has paid of this amount the sum of $
11.50,leaving a balance due of $ 8.30; and Whereas, the said Tom Stebney, colored, died on
the 24th day of May past and can no longer continue to pay the monthly installments due
upon his hiring bond ,upon which W S Walsh, was a surety.
Now Therefore,
Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin, Texas : That in consideration of
the extreme equities of the case,the balance of the fine and costs in this case,amounting
to $ 8.30,be and the same is hereby remitted.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote: Yeas Mayor Wooldridge, Councilmen
Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 7 Nays none,
Approved, A P Wooldridge, Mayor.
